test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is correctly matched?

options.text: Units of force – Joule, Horsepower, Torr
Units of work done – Newton, Pascal, Bar
Units of pressure – Pascal, Bar and Torr
Units of volume – Kilogram, Gram, Metre

solution:
The correct answer is __**Units of pressure – Pascal, Bar and Torr**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pressure is classified into the following types**:

 
 
• Absolute pressure.
 
• Gauge pressure.
 
• Differential pressure.
 
• Sealed pressure or vacuum pressure.
 
 
 
• The **force delivered perpendicularly **to **an object's surface per unit area **across which that **force is dispersed **is known as **pressure**.
 
• In **comparison **to the **surrounding pressure**, **gauge pressure **is the **pressure**.
 
• **Pressure is expressed **using **a variety of units**.
 
 
• The **SI unit for pressure is pascals **(Pa).
 
• Other **units of pressure **include **T****orr**, Barr, atm, at, ba, psi, and **manometric units like mm Hg and fsw.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The I**nternational System of Units **(SI), commonly known as the** metric system**, is the international standard for measurement. 
 
• The **1960** International System builds on the **MKS system**.
 
• The SI is made up of **7 base units** that define the** 22 derived units** with special names and symbols.
 
• **The seven basic units are listed in the chart below.**
